routing_finding.interpretation: The four-channel stream links directly to hardware. The speaker DAC consumes the second PCM channel pair; retargeting the current stereo engine by name alone would link its ports 0/1 to FL/FR, not the speaker-associated RL/RR ports 2/3.

limits: All-zero PCM is an active graph observation, not representative music/CPU load or an audible acceptance test.
The client requests 4800/48000; the active graph negotiated 2048/48000 on both hosts, larger than the idle metadata default 1024/48000. This does not characterize all clients.
Graph periods, reported ProcessLatency, ALSA period/buffer sizes and one unsynchronised kernel delay sample are not physical event-to-speaker or round-trip latency.
ThinkPad driver ERR reached one before the first running sample and stayed one; no zero-error activation or long-run stability claim is made.
No reboot, session restart, profile change, volume setter, DSP configuration change, service restart or recording occurred in these captures.
Actual post-reboot startup, physical routing/resume, acoustic qualification and comparable M4 Air measurements remain pending.

method.active: Ten seconds of generated all-zero 48 kHz signed-16-bit PCM through auto-selected current physical default, with six pw-top snapshots and two active graphs.
method.active_client: pw-play native PipeWire client with its default requested 100 ms latency.
method.idle: Read-only graph, metadata, node/port latency, ALSA proc state and six pw-top snapshots.

source_findings.multichannel_matching: src/pw_link_manager.cpp falls back to equal port IDs when an unsupported channel label, including RL/RR, is present.
source_findings.pipeline_idle: src/stream_output_effects.cpp unlinks inactive filters after the configured timeout; default inactivity timer is enabled with a ten-second timeout.
source_findings.speaker_routing: src/speaker_routing.hpp requires the exact configured physical sink and active speaker route before correction/interception.
